title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
description: Harness^2 improves frozen-model agents on unseen tasks by contrasting executions of proposed harness edits, composing supported changes, and retaining reusable refinement experience to guide future tasks without ground-truth feedback during adaptation. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Ruiyao Xu et al., arXiv:2610.14224v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224v1
